title: Open-Meteo historical archive, Shanghai grid point, 23 November-1 December 2025
claims: The archive request for 31.2304N, 121.4737E returned the grid point 31.2478N, 121.5E at 5 m elevation.
The nine-day window 23 November-1 December 2025 had daily maximum temperatures from 13.5 to 22.8 degrees Celsius, with a median of 18.2 degrees.
Daily minimum temperatures ranged from 1.9 to 12.1 degrees Celsius, with a median of 7.5 degrees.
None of the nine days recorded daily precipitation of at least 1 mm.
On race day, 30 November 2025, the grid gives a maximum of 22.8 degrees, a minimum of 8.6 degrees and 0.0 mm precipitation.
